title: refactor(hits): remove unneeded defaultProps
body:
**Summary**

Removed defaultProps from Hits component as the props are always present (similar finding as in #4986)

Also made defaultProps forbidden via eslint (for function components, classes can come when they're refactored to functions)

**Result**

* defaultProps is used in no further function components
* eslint will error if defaultProps is used by a function component
